units.name: SndEnvelopeTable
units.summary: Volume envelopes: 16-byte rows of volume steps, $FF ends a row. Row chosen by command $Ex (SndEnvIndex = x*16), stepped by SndEnvelopeStep.

units.name: SndPeriodTable
units.summary: Note period tables (16-bit APU timer values) for note numbers 0-15; the second table is used when the note byte has bit 7 set. The period is shifted right SndChOctave times. SndNoteLengthTable: 32 note lengths in frames (commands $5x and $6x).

regions.summary: Code bank 00 $8184-$87E6: SndMusicTick, SndEffectTick, SndStartMusic, SndToggleMusicPause, SndStartEffect, SndCheckEffectPriority, SndStart_Return, SndDisableChannel .... Per-frame tick: music channels, then effect channels.

units.name: SndTick
units.summary: Per-frame tick: music channels, then effect channels.

units.name: SndStart
units.summary: Start sound SoundStartId. $00-$1F: music (SndStartMusic); $80+: toggle music pause (SndToggleMusicPause); $20-$3F: effect - header from the effect table. Effect $39 is only accepted while effect $3A is playing; while an effect plays, a new one replaces it only if its priority byte is not lower.

units.name: SndStartEffect
units.summary: Effect header: priority byte, then two channel pointers (square 2, noise).

units.name: SndStartMusic
units.summary: Music header: tempo byte, then four channel pointers. All four music channels start with a 1-frame timer; loop/envelope state is cleared.

units.name: SndToggleMusicPause
units.summary: Silence the four music channels and flip SndStatus bit 7 (music on/off).

units.name: SndMusicTick
units.summary: Count the tempo divider; on expiry process the four music channels.

units.name: SndProcessChannels
units.summary: Channel loop (X = record offset, SndChanBit, SndCount). An inactive channel is skipped; a running note only updates its envelope/vibrato (SndUpdateEnvelope); when the timer expires the next sequence command is executed (SndNextCommand).

units.name: SndNextCommand
units.summary: Read the command byte at SndDataPtr and jump to SndCommandTable[byte>>4]. Handlers return through SndAdvancePtr or loop back here.

units.name: SndNextChannel
units.summary: Effect pass skips one record (effects use square 2 and noise only).

units.name: SndCmd0_End
units.summary: Command $0x/$1x: end of channel data. Music: clear the channel bit; when all music channels have ended, a nonzero byte chains to that music id, zero stops the music. Effects: hand the channel back to the music settings (SndSq2Ctrl/SndNoiseCtrl) and stop the effect when both channels ended.

units.name: SndCmd2_Note
units.summary: Command $2x/$Dx: play a note. Restarts the volume envelope, then writes period and length. The noise channel takes the period from the low nibble (SndWriteNoise); tonal channels look up SndPeriodTable/Alt.

units.name: SndCmd3_Octave
units.summary: Command $3x: set the octave shift to x (not used on noise).

units.name: SndCmd4_Rest
units.summary: Command $4x: rest - restart the note timer and silence the channel.

units.name: SndCmd5_Length
units.summary: Commands $5x/$6x: note length from SndNoteLengthTable (x or x+16).

units.name: SndCmd7_Hold
units.summary: Command $7x: restart the timer; $77 just holds, other values retrigger the current note. Exact use is inferred.

units.name: SndCmd8_Volume
units.summary: Command $8x: set constant volume x and stop this channel's envelope.

units.name: SndCmd9_Duty
units.summary: Command $9x: duty cycle bits (square) or the triangle control value.

units.name: SndCmdA_Repeat
units.summary: Command $Ax: repeat blocks with two nesting levels. Bits 0/2 select the loop start (next byte = repeat count, pointer saved in SndLoopPtr), bits 1/3 the loop end (decrement and jump back while the count is nonzero).

units.name: SndCmdB_SweepNote
units.summary: Command $Bx: note x with the next byte as sweep register value.

units.name: SndSweepOff
units.summary: For the square channels write $08 (sweep disabled) and silence it.

units.name: SndCmdC_Sweep
units.summary: Command $Cx: write the following byte (OR $80) to the sweep register.

units.name: SndCmdE_Envelope
units.summary: Command $Ex: select volume envelope x and start it.

units.name: SndUpdateEnvelope
units.summary: While a note sounds: advance its envelope (SndEnvelopeStep) or vibrato (SndUpdateVibrato).

units.name: SndEnvelopeStep
units.summary: Write the next envelope volume; $FF (high nibble set) ends the envelope.

units.name: SndCmdF_Vibrato
units.summary: Command $Fx: vibrato setup for tonal channels: bit 3 off, bits 0-2 depth and speed (stored in SndVibDepth / SndVibState).

units.name: SndUpdateVibrato
units.summary: Oscillate the period low byte around the note by the vibrato step, reversing direction (bit 6) at the depth limit.

units.name: SndEffectTick
units.summary: Process the two effect channels (X = $28, SndCount 3 and 1).

units.name: SndEnableChannel
units.summary: SND_CHN |= channel bit (register offset $15 = $4015).

units.name: SndDisableChannel
units.summary: Routine SndDisableChannel: short helper/entry; its role is given by the name and the enclosing block comment.

units.name: SndNextByte
units.summary: Routine SndNextByte: short helper/entry; its role is given by the name and the enclosing block comment.

units.name: SndWriteReg
units.summary: Write SndArg to APU register (4 - SndCount)*4 + SndRegOffset. Music writes to a channel currently owned by an effect are dropped. Writes to $4015 also update SndChnShadow.

units.name: SndWriteNoise
units.summary: Routine SndWriteNoise: short helper/entry; its role is given by the name and the enclosing block comment.

units.name: SndInit
units.summary: Stop everything: clear SndChnShadow, stop music and effects.

units.name: SndStopMusic
units.summary: Silence all music channels, clear the channel bits and zero every APU register; sweeps disabled ($08).

units.name: MulCos16
units.summary: Trigonometry on signed 16-bit Ptr04: MulCos16 multiplies by cos(A) by adding a quarter turn ($40) and falling into MulSin16. Angles are 0-255 per turn. editorial_audit.notes: Round 5 final editorial review (2026-11-18) on pass-007 (map d0dd6e1f...). Scope: the changed range (b10 $9B08), all known open items, automated sweeps over all banks (auto labels, address-only locals, raw RAM operands, unexplained Unknown/Data ranges, heads/eols landing, cross-bank numeric operands vs. their 'bank NN Label' comments, certainty words such as unused/dead/never, opcode-paraphrase comments, pointer tables stored as raw bytes, data regions with no explanatory comment) and sampled reading of one block per bank. Findings fixed: (1) b10 $9B08 rewritten as `.byte $60` with a note stating the user-directed Manual fallback, unknown meaning and the open RTS-vs-pad ambiguity (L-R3-01). (2) Wrong name/role: MenuBoxDrawPtrs/CallMenuBoxDrawer patched an inline text pointer, not a JSR target; renamed SubMenuTextPtrs/DrawSubMenuText, the five text records named (TxtSub*), trampoline and RAM comments corrected. (3) Missing structures/boundaries: pointer words plus named targets for TeamNameTextPtrs, MenuTextBlockPtrs (b2), TeamCursorShapes, GridLayoutPtrs, ResultMascotPtrs (b3), DefaultLineupPtrs, ScoreboardMessagePtrs (b9), SndCommandTable/SndTablePtrs (b0); TeamBufPtrs (b7) split from the cursor sprites that follow it (ViewTeamCursorSprites); bank-2 menu table cluster and scoreboard message format documented. (4) FixedTables_FF80 head now names entries 16-24 (bank-10 name entry, reached by far jumps from bank 7; FarDrawPortrait) and the four bank-7 far jumps carry target comments. (5) Misleading certainty: Unused04F4/BenchListUnused renamed WriteOnly04F4/BenchListWriteOnly (no reader found). (6) Vague name MenuMiscTable renamed Sprite0SplitTemplate; SigConst* RAM symbols commented; bank-0 period-table head uses labels instead of raw addresses. (7) 'Referenced from' lines for pointers held in data tables now name the table, not the routine before it (local build tool). Accepted conventions: short self-describing tables/texts named by role without their own head (their consumers' heads document the format); songs/animations/field areas by id; scratch reuse of field RAM documented in uncertainties.md; cross-bank operands from fixed banks stay numeric with 'probably bank NN Label' comments. Unresolved (documented): $9B08 meaning, $A07B overlap intent, reachability of no-known-caller fragments.
